free_tier.stated: Free Tier for 12 months: 1,000 build minutes a month on the standard 4 vCPU / 8 GB instance, 5 GB of CDN storage, 15 GB a month of data transfer out, 500,000 server-side rendering requests and 100 GB-hours a month of SSR duration. After 12 months every line is metered, and new accounts since 2025-07-15 get up to USD 200 in credits on a free plan that lasts 6 months.

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: the unit is a machine, not an object
per_object_cap.notes: The primary constraint is the virtual machine hardware specification.

retention.stated: the 12-month clock ends the allowance regardless of use, and the build instance is the only 4 vCPU / 8 GB shape among evaluated providers, which makes the build minutes the useful part rather than the hosting.
retention.notes: a machine record: what is lost is the running process, not a stored object

evidence.proved: 'Deploy an app with AWS Free Tier: Free for 12 months'; standard instance 8 GB memory, 4 vCPUs, no cost up to 1,000 build minutes per month, quoted
no cost up to 5 GB stored on CDN, 15 GB per month data transfer out, 500,000 SSR requests per month, 100 GB-hours per month SSR duration, quoted
from 2025-07-15 new AWS customers get up to USD 200 in Free Tier credits; the free plan is available for 6 months after account creation and all credits must be used within 12 months, quoted
15 GB per month is free with the AWS Free Tier and the overage is USD 0.15 per GB
evidence.quote: | Data transfer out | No cost up to 15 GB per month | $0.15 per GB served |

notes: The 100 GB-hours of SSR duration is the number worth having: at 1 GB of provisioned memory it is 100 hours of server-side render a month, roughly three hours a day, and it is the only hyperscaler allowance among evaluated providers denominated in GB-hours. Possibilities: (a) the free tier is perpetual for Amplify; refuted, the table says 'Free for 12 months'. (b) A card is required; inferred from AWS account creation, not read on this page. Open: whether the USD 200 credit and the 12-month Amplify tier can both be used, which the page implies but does not state.
